answer: Each identity posts a 50-credit bond and starts one challenge chain. The atlas maps every vertex to its chain head. Each epoch it must answer a challenge chained to its prior proof; a stalled or forked chain is pruned from the garden of identities and its bond slashed. The kth fake needs its own 50-credit bond plus 5 credits of proof, so 1,000 fakes lock 50,000 credits and pay 5,000 per epoch. Chain rental fails: a replayed chain reuses a head bound to another vertex key, and the atlas exposes the fork. An honest agent posts one bond, keeps one chain and its full share.
